summary:
The Statement Writer (TV's fifth Layout Editor tab, 'Design Statements') does not exist in VV at all. On the TV side it is 33 files and 16,898 lines in LE/52__Feature__StatementWriter (data, markdown engine, page, editor, reader, PDF, publish, styles, six standard sections), plus a 451-line local-server API and 14 test files. Devlog: v2.95 to v2.172, all dated 20 to 29 Sep 2026, and every entry says 'NOT confirmed by Adam'. VV has no copy of any of this: no ledger row, no transport, no statement documents in any of its 97 projects. The folder lands at the identical path (52 is free in VV LE) and about 13,900 lines port verbatim.

The real work is in four places:
- **VV's own transport (DIV-4).** It needs a new authenticated worker handler, a new Flask blueprint, an AppUtils client and a rewritten Transport unit.
- **Five TV-only systems the page imports statically:** DocumentKeys+KeyScope, the ContextMenu renderer, ProjectQrCode, DocumentSharing (which imports Statement Data back) and DrawingRegister.
- **Wiring:** the config block and GetStatementSetup, ModeController VIEW_STATEMENT/OpenStatements, the VV loader facade and the TabStrip 2.0.0 tab, Open Sans 500, vendored html2canvas, the PdfExporter LoadLibrary export, a SW token bump and a .gitignore allowlist.
- **Vale branding** of NA content: logo, author, copyright, the TrueVision Hub section and the localStorage keys.

Found with evidence:
- **(1) The tokeniser only reads LF line endings.** With autocrlf, git checks statements out as CRLF, and a CRLF statement then renders with no headings, rules or tables. RB05 is CRLF on disk today, and 5 of TV's 7 statement suites fail on 01-Oct. VV's repo has the same git settings.
- **(2) VV's Flask catch-all route answers a missing file with index.html and HTTP 200.** The VV transport must never read statement files through it.
- **(3) VV's global hotkeys ignore contenteditable.** Typing in a statement would lose R/B/T/Y/V/F/1-9, and Backspace would navigate back.
- **(4) TV's Spec lockstep (v2.163) imports the Statement Lockstep leaf.** That leaf has to be ported first.

Recommendation: port it, as the identical engine and tab with Vale words and VV's own transport, behind a LayoutEditor__Statement__Enabled switch. Do it last among the LE parity work, from a pinned TV commit, after Adam signs the feature off and the CRLF fix lands. Port the Lockstep leaf now.

findings.title: Statement Writer (Design Statements tab) is absent from VV - scope decision
findings.detail: TV's fifth Layout Editor tab (TabStrip 2.0.0, v2.158) is the Statement Writer: 33 files / 16,898 lines in LE/52__Feature__StatementWriter, a 451-line local-server API and 14 test files. VV has none of it, no ledger row, and no statement documents in any of its 97 2026 projects. The content layer (header, hub, footer, finishes) is NA/UK-planning specific and every TV release v2.95-v2.172 still says 'NOT confirmed by Adam'.
findings.recommendation: In scope as the identical engine and tab with Vale words and VV's own transport, gated by a new LayoutEditor__Statement__Enabled switch (default on). Schedule it last in the LE parity sequence, from a pinned TV commit after Adam's sign-off and the CRLF fix. Port the Lockstep leaf now regardless (S07b-F04).
findings.evidence: drift_all.tsv: 33 rows tv-only; VV LE has no 52__ subfolder; WCP/Projects/2026 (97 projects) has no *statement*/DAS/heritage file; TV devlog v2.95-v2.172 each 'NOT confirmed by Adam'.

Keep all 15 exports and their result shapes so every other module ports verbatim.

findings.title: Markdown engine - five pure modules
findings.detail: 02__Core__Markdown: Tokenise 1.0.0 (501), Inline 1.0.0 (421), Render 1.2.0 (397; expanders v2.162, figure card v2.165), Serialise 1.0.0 (287), Md__Figure 1.0.0 (474; v2.165). They are pure string modules that keep the byte-for-byte promise: untouched blocks are copied with their blank lines. Only Render has a console prefix to change.
findings.recommendation: Port verbatim, with the CRLF fix from S07b-F10 made in TV first. RoundTrip and FigureTitle node suites must pass on a VV fixture.
findings.evidence: imports: Figure->Tokenise+Inline; Render->Tokenise+Inline; Serialise->Inline. TV NOTES section 3: touching tokeniser/renderer/serialiser requires all three round-trip tests.

findings.title: LF-only tokeniser + autocrlf checkouts: CRLF statements lose every heading, rule and table
findings.detail: Md__Tokenise__ splits lines on LF only (:264) and its block regexes are end-anchored (:65-73). A JS dot does not match a carriage return, so a CRLF statement tokenises as paragraphs and HTML only. RB05's statement is CRLF on disk (2,212 CRLF; git i/lf w/crlf; core.autocrlf=true; text=auto), so TV today renders it with no headings, dividers or tables, and 5 of 7 statement suites fail. VV's repo has the same autocrlf and text=auto settings.
findings.recommendation: Fix in TV first (D-S07b-02), then port. In both repos, add a .gitattributes eol=lf rule for md/html/json under 10__StatementDocs. Make the tokeniser accept CRLF while keeping the source lines byte-exact, and add a CRLF case to RoundTrip. Never normalise on read.
findings.evidence: TV run 01-Oct: RoundTrip 'every heading found (0 of 138)', blocks 'html 107, paragraph 449'. git ls-files --eol RB05_T01_S01: i/lf w/crlf attr/text=auto. VV repo: core.autocrlf=true, '* text=auto'.

findings.title: Document manager (create, rename, delete, adopt)
findings.detail: Statement__Manager__.js 1.1.0 (407 lines; v2.95, v2.169 authors only) is the sheet that creates statements (the name is previewed before commit), renames, deletes (entry vs folder) and adopts statements found on disk. It uses ConfirmDialog, which in VV shows the styled #naConfirmDialog modal instead of TV's window.confirm. Its placeholder text is 'Design and Access Statement' (:308).
findings.recommendation: Port verbatim; keep the placeholder unless D-S07b-04 changes the UK-planning wording.
findings.evidence: imports Data (List, GetState, NameFor, Create, Rename, Delete, Adopt) and ConfirmDialog; VV index.html :1323 has #naConfirmDialog, TV Index.html has none.

findings.title: The Statements tab page
findings.detail: Statement__Page__.js 1.6.0 (1,039 lines) holds the bar, picker, status, Edit/Read, Standard Sections menu, Save, Publish, PDF presets, Share, Manage, alerts, progress, lockstep sheet and DocumentKeys actions (v2.110 1.1.0, v2.157 1.2.0, v2.162 1.3.0, v2.166 1.4.0, v2.167 1.5.0, v2.169 1.6.0). findings.recommendation: port_adapted: rename the keys to Na__ValeVision__ and use a neutral menu title; keep the stylesheet self-injection (:824-834). Land it after its prerequisites (S07b-F15, F34, F35, F36), or the module graph will not link.
findings.evidence: Page__.js imports :126-168; Mount :817-905; Show/Hide :968-1018; BuildBar :277-360.

findings.title: Editor, typing rules and section Move
findings.detail: Editor__.js 1.4.0 (683; v2.95, v2.162, v2.165, v2.167, v2.168), Editor__Typing__.js 1.0.0 (570; v2.95) and Editor__Move__.js 1.1.0 (323; v2.162) make up the contenteditable page. findings.title: Reader (the Read view the PDF photographs)
findings.detail: Reader__.js 1.1.0 (178; v2.95, v2.171) is the Read view: no handles, and A4 paper that shrinks on narrow desks. It is the element the PDF rasterises. Off localhost it shows the CDN copies listed in Doc__Images. Readers (non-authoring sessions) only ever get this view.

findings.evidence: imports Tokenise, Render, Data, Images and ProjectLoader IsRunningOnLocalhost (present in VV :303-307).

findings.title: Rasterised pageless PDF
findings.detail: Statement__Pdf__.js 1.2.0 (449; v2.95, v2.99 presets, v2.162 link annotations/Unzoom, v2.171 OwnSize) puts html2canvas tiles of a Reader clone onto pageless jsPDF pages (cap 14,399 pt), with zero extractable text by policy and clickable links. findings.recommendation: Port verbatim after S07b-F37 and S07b-F38. Keep the raster policy (D-S07b-07). Verify zero text with the TV NOTES section 13 fitz check.
findings.evidence: Pdf__.js imports ConfigState, PdfExporter LoadLibrary; VV PdfExporter exports :332-336; VV 04__Lib__ThirdParty__VersionLocked has folders 01-04 only.

findings.title: Publish and picture publishing call TV's CfApi and LocalMirror directly
findings.detail: Statement__Publish__.js 1.2.0 (349; v2.95, v2.170, v2.171) and Publish__Images__.js 1.2.0 (312; v2.95, v2.170, v2.172) run Publish: save, send only linked pictures (2000 px WebP), build the HTML, write a companion .html locally, send the markdown, and stamp the index last. Both call TV CfApi directly (Publish :107-112, :245, :271, :282, :326; Images :95-96, :223, :256, :273). Publish also calls LocalMirror (:277). Images reads the originals from location.repoUrl (:263).
findings.recommendation: port_adapted: route every write and location through the Transport unit (VV worker and Flask), and read originals through a 404-honest VV URL (S07b-F29). Better: do the routing in TV first (S07b-F51).
findings.evidence: Line refs above. TV v2.172 dry run: 36 pictures written at their link keys as image/webp, image/jpeg and image/png; index stamped last.

findings.title: Published page builder - one branded string
findings.detail: Publish__Page__.js 1.0.0 (401; v2.170) is pure. It writes viewport 842 and color-scheme, the app's @font-face rules made absolute, the app reset (identical to VV's BaseLayout :7-11), the document stylesheet without comments, srcset 2000w with sizes for resized pictures, and the title from the Document Header. findings.title: Chrome and document stylesheets
findings.detail: Styles__Statement__.css (1,049) is the chrome. It uses only the --Na_Le_Stage/Ink/InkMuted/Chrome/ChromeRule/ChromeShadow/PaperShadow tokens, all defined in VV's Styles__Surfaces__.css, and .na-le-btn classes (VV Panels CSS :528-572). findings.title: Standard sections config JSON carries NA words
findings.detail: Standard__Config__.json (191 lines) holds every standard-section word: the NA logo URL, 'Prepared By: Mr Adam Noble of Noble Architecture', UK planning header fields, the TrueVision hub copy (published through TrueVision 3D, Noble Architecture's own platform), the footer copyright 'Noble Architecture', schedule columns and finishes rules. findings.title: Registry, Contents, Finishes and Drawing Schedule - pure section modules
findings.detail: Registry (818 lines; 1.0-1.3 over v2.162/v2.167/v2.168), Contents 1.0.0 (248), Finishes 1.0.0 (644) and DrawingSchedule 1.0.0 (579) are pure string modules: markers, placement anchors (Top, HeaderDivider, Standard:, BeforeStandard:, SectionsEnd, End, Caret), the expander, the sync API, the contents list, the finishes comparison and the schedule merge. Registry's DEFINITIONS (:155-162) is a static list that includes the TrueVision hub. The Contents fallback (:77) names TrueVision's Statement Writer.

findings.title: Drawing Schedule live source needs the Drawing Register
findings.detail: Standard__DrawingSchedule__Live__.js 1.0.0 (140 lines; v2.167) reads Na__LeRegPdf__Rows from LE/51__Feature__DrawingRegister/Na__LayoutEditor__Register__Pdf__.js, which is TV-only. It also reads the Specification's notes, document number and revision; all five SpecData exports it uses exist in VV. findings.title: The TrueVision 3D Project Hub section in VV
findings.detail: Standard__TrueVisionHub__.js 1.1.0 (323 lines; v2.162, reworded by b884e290) is entirely TrueVision-branded. Its id is 'TrueVisionHub'; it says 'Explore This Proposal In TrueVision 3D' and 'Open {ProjectName} In TrueVision 3D'. findings.title: Header and Footer defaults (NA logo, author, copyright)
findings.detail: Standard__Header__.js 1.0.0 (324; v2.162) has NA defaults: the NA logo URL (:86), 'Prepared By: Mr Adam Noble of Noble Architecture' (:94) and alt 'Noble Architecture' (:208). Standard__Footer__.js 1.0.0 (311; v2.167) defaults the copyright to Noble Architecture (:93). Both repeat the config JSON as built-in fallbacks. Their take-over and unwrap logic is generic.

findings.title: VV Flask blueprint for statement files
findings.detail: TV's NAAPPS/ProjectVision__TrueVisionStatements__Api__.py (451 lines) provides tree, file, image, folder, move and delete routes fenced to one statements folder. Patterns are checked after path resolution, sizes are capped, pictures are never overwritten, and delete needs confirm equal to path. The index is written through LocalServer's sibling route (:103-105). VV's Flask (WCP/server.py) registers only the scrapbook blueprint (:96) and has no statement route.
findings.recommendation: Create WCP/Server__ValeVisionStatements__Api__.py as an adapted port, the way Server__ValeVisionScrapbook__Api__ was done. Root it at Projects/{year}/{folder}/10__StatementDocs via get_project_path, use the prefix /api/valevision/statements and keep TV's rules. Add index GET/POST and a file GET that returns Last-Modified, or a 404 JSON when missing. Register it in server.py.
findings.evidence: TV API constants :68-84, routes :177-449. VV server.py :92-96 blueprint registration. Scrapbook API port note: adapted (folder, prefix, blueprint name).

findings.title: VV worker handler for statement R2 reads and writes
findings.detail: Publish writes the markdown, HTML and pictures to R2, and the index too. TV uses the generic, unauthenticated /r2/write over NaProjectPortal/. VV's worker (whitecardopedia-editor-api) routes per document and checks X-Editor-Api-Key. Its ProjectAsset handler allows only PresentationMode/Thumbnails and LayoutEditor Linework/Snapshots paths (webp/png/json), so no existing VV route can take statement files.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudflareHandler__StatementDocs__.js with GET/POST /api/editor/projects/{folderId}/statements/index and /statements/file?path= (text or base64 body, contentType). Guard keys to VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/10__StatementDocs/ using TV's segment, suffix and depth rules, with a 25 MB cap. Route it in index.js before the generic save route. Adam deploys.
findings.evidence: VV worker index.js key check :112-116 and :148, routes :190-214; ProjectAsset handler PATH_GUARD :51, MAX_BYTES 25 MB :52.

findings.title: VV client module Na__AppUtils__R2StatementDocs__
findings.detail: TV's statement modules reach the cloud through CfApi (7 functions) and disk through LocalMirror (6 functions). VV has neither. VV's pattern is one AppUtils module per document: R2DrawingNotes does a worker GET/POST with the key from /api/editor-config, falls back to the CDN, and mirrors to Flask.
findings.recommendation: Create VVM/03__AppUtils/Na__AppUtils__R2StatementDocs__.js. It provides index read/write (cloud and local), statement read (local with Last-Modified, worker, CDN), text and picture write (cloud and local), tree, make folder, move, delete and location builders. The Transport unit is its only caller.
findings.evidence: Transport imports CfApi :82-90 and LocalMirror :92-99. VV R2DrawingNotes header :12-19 (ReadCloud, Write, WriteLocal, ReadLocal); R2SaveProjectJson exports R2FetchWorkerConfig.

findings.title: VV catch-all static route answers a missing file with index.html and HTTP 200
findings.detail: WCP/server.py serve_static (:956-977) answers any missing file with index.html and HTTP 200. TV's FetchText treats only 404/403 as missing, and Publish__Images reads originals by URL. Through this route a missing statement would load the Whitecardopedia index page as its text, and a missing picture would be uploaded as HTML. TV's static server returns real 404s, so the problem is VV-specific.
findings.recommendation: Never read statement files through the catch-all route. Use the blueprint's file GET (404 JSON plus Last-Modified), or /Whitecardopedia/Projects/..., which returns a 404 JSON when the file is missing (server.py :899-912). Add a test that a missing file reads as missing.
findings.evidence: server.py :966-977: when the file is not found it returns send_from_directory(base_dir, 'index.html'). Transport__.js FetchText :134-143.

findings.title: VV storage layout: statements folder, index file, R2 keys, CDN
findings.detail: TV stores statements at <project>/30__TrueVision__AppContent/10__StatementDocs/<folder>/<file>, with the index TrueVision__StatementDocs__.json beside TrueVision__ProjectData__.json. R2 is NaProjectPortal/{yy}-Projects/{folder}/... and the CDN is cdn.noble-architecture.com/NaProjectPortal/.... VV keeps project documents beside project.json under WCP/Projects/{year}/{folder}/ and in R2 under VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/ (e.g. ValeVision__DrawingNotes__.json).
findings.recommendation: VV layout (D-S07b-03): Projects/{year}/{folder}/10__StatementDocs/; index ValeVision__StatementDocs__.json beside project.json; R2 VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/10__StatementDocs/...; CDN cdn.noble-architecture.com/VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/.... Set FolderName and IndexFileName in config, and keep the in-folder conventions.
findings.evidence: TV CfApi :509-534, :616-676. VV R2DrawingNotes CDN base https://cdn.noble-architecture.com/VaApps/Projects; VV server get_project_path :128-160.

findings.title: Config block, GetStatementSetup and tab labels missing in VV
findings.detail: Eight statement modules call Na__LeCfg__GetStatementSetup, which VV lacks: VV EditorSetup 1.0.0 exports only 7 readers (:209-217). VV AppConfig has no LayoutEditor__Statement__Config block (TV :1271-1330: 37 keys including PdfPresets, Html2CanvasScriptPath and LockstepPollMs), and no StatementsTab/StatementsTabTitle labels (TV :595-596).
findings.recommendation: Add the block with VV values: FolderName, IndexFileName ValeVision__StatementDocs__.json, StylesheetUrl on VV's public origin (to verify) and Html2CanvasScriptPath. Add the two labels and an optional Enabled switch. Copy GetStatementSetup (TV EditorSetup :163-210) into VV EditorSetup and re-export it from ConfigState__.
findings.evidence: TV AppConfig :1271-1330 and :595-596; TV EditorSetup :170-210; TV ConfigState__ :293, :429.

findings.title: ModeController has no statement view
findings.detail: TV ModeController 1.32.0 imports Page Mount/Show/Hide and Data OPEN_EVENT/Initialize (:361-363) and declares VIEW_STATEMENT (:431). It initialises and mounts the page for editor and viewer alike, before the viewer branch (:503-504). It hides the page on every other open (:691, :766, :901, :933), opens it with EnterUnder (:942-972) and listens for OPEN_EVENT (:1230). VV ModeController 1.18.0 has only sheet and spec views (:287-288) and returns early for the viewer (:401-407).
findings.recommendation: Add the statement lines as part of the ModeController/TabStrip slice's port, mounting before the viewer branch. Until VV has the register, leave Na__LeRegEd__Hide out of OpenStatements and record that in the PORT NOTE.
findings.evidence: Line refs above; TV devlog v2.158 (EnterUnder, quiet entry) and v2.166 (options).

findings.title: VV loader facade and TabStrip need the statements view
findings.detail: VV's TabStrip may import only the loader facade (TabStrip :103-131). The facade mirrors the editor's view names (VIEW_SHEET/VIEW_SPEC :115-116), checks them against the editor (CheckNames :284-290) and exposes OpenSpecification via WithEditor. TV TabStrip 2.0.0 builds the Design Statements tab from VIEW_STATEMENT and OpenStatements (:155, :159, :358-361). VV TabStrip 1.5.0 has per-sheet tabs and no statements tab.
findings.recommendation: In the loader, add Na__LeLoad__VIEW_STATEMENT ('statement'), a CheckNames row, and Na__LeLoad__OpenStatements(options), which calls the editor's OpenStatements through WithEditor; export them. Build the tab in the TabStrip 2.0.0 port through the facade, and honour the Enabled switch.
findings.evidence: VV Loader :108-133 constants/STYLESHEETS, :284-290 CheckNames; VV TabStrip imports :108-131.

findings.title: Keyboard: VV's 3D hotkeys would eat statement typing, and Backspace navigates back
findings.detail: VV's global hotkey handler (03__AppUtils/Na__AppUtils__ValeVision__HotkeyHandler__.js) treats only input, textarea and select as typing (:51-55, :92). It binds R, B, T, Y, V, F, 1-9, PageUp/PageDown, and Backspace to ValeVision__App__NavigateBack. The statement page is contenteditable, so those keys would be swallowed while typing and Backspace would leave the page: the same fault TV fixed in v2.110 with KeyScope + DocumentKeys. The Page also imports DocumentKeys statically.
findings.recommendation: Before WP-S07b-05 ships, port 03__AppUtils/Na__AppUtils__KeyScope__.js 1.1.0 and LE/31__System__DocumentKeys (1.1.0 + Na__Hotkeys__DocumentTabs__.json). Have the ModeController hand over the scope reader, and make VV's handler act only in the model scope, counting contenteditable as typing.
findings.evidence: VV HotkeyHandler :51-55, :91-99; 02__AppData/Na__ValeVision__HotkeysDictionary__.json Backspace binding (:182); TV devlog v2.110 :5496-5573.

findings.title: Document Sharing and Statement Data depend on each other; keep Share__Open off VV start-up
findings.detail: The Page imports Share__Button__ (Share in Read). Share__Open__ (:78), Share__Manifest__ (:97-98) and Share__Button__ (:71) import Statement Data back (EnsureLoaded, List, CHANGED_EVENT), and the manifest re-records share links when a statement is published (:450-462). TV starts Share__Open__ from Index.html at start-up (:904). Doing the same in VV would pull Statement Data and its transport onto the start-up path, which defeats the lazy loader.
findings.recommendation: Port Statement Data before or together with DocumentSharing. Start Share__Open__ through the VV loader once the editor has loaded, never from index.html. If statements are ruled out of scope, DocumentSharing needs a statement-free VV adaptation (D-S07b-01).
findings.evidence: Line refs above; VV Loader header: editor modules are only ever import()ed.

findings.title: Project QR Code is a static import of the page, the publisher and the hub
findings.detail: The Page and Publish import Na__ProjectQr__Ready and READY_EVENT. The hub imports Symbol, Painter and ProjectLink (53__Feature__ProjectQrCode: Symbol 1.2.0, Encoder, Painter, ProjectLink; about 1,682 lines). Because these are static imports, the module must exist in VV even if the hub is excluded, and Publish waits on its config.
findings.recommendation: Sequence after the ProjectQrCode port (another slice). Its short-address base must be VV's own, since VV has no /q/ resolver yet. With no symbol, the hub leaves its access panel out by design.
findings.evidence: Page imports :156; Publish imports :111; TrueVisionHub imports Symbol/Painter/ProjectLink.

findings.title: Na__LePdf__LoadLibrary export missing in VV PdfExporter
findings.detail: The statement PDF imports Na__LePdf__LoadLibrary (TV PdfExporter 1.12.0 :192-205, exported at :579 as 'jsPDF ALONE, for the statement PDF'). VV PdfExporter 1.2.0 has the same function under the name Na__LePdf__EnsureJsPdf (:97-112) and exports only EnsureJsPdf, BuildDocument and ExportSheet (:332-336). VV's jsPDF is 4.1.0 at the legacy 35__System__PageLayoutSystem path (AppConfig :402).
findings.recommendation: If the PdfExporter port has not landed, add a one-line alias export (Na__LePdf__LoadLibrary = Na__LePdf__EnsureJsPdf) to VV's PdfExporter, which is a hot file.
findings.evidence: Line refs above.

findings.title: Vendor html2canvas 1.4.1 into VV
findings.detail: The statement PDF and two harnesses load html2canvas 1.4.1 from 04__Lib__ThirdParty__VersionLocked/06__Vendor__Html2Canvas__v1.4.1/html2canvas.umd.js (LayoutEditor__Statement__Html2CanvasScriptPath). VV's version-locked folder has only 01 three.js, 02 mesh-bvh, 03 clipper2 and 04 edge-projection.
findings.recommendation: Vendor TV's html2canvas.umd.js at the same path in VV and note it in Vale__Dependencies__VersionLock__README__.md. It is a classic script, not an import-map entry.
findings.evidence: TV AppConfig :1330; ls VV 04__Lib__ThirdParty__VersionLocked.

findings.title: Bump VV's service worker token with the release
findings.detail: VV runs under the WebApps-level service worker, whose logic is WCP/02__Src__AppModules/62__Feature__AppInstallability/Whitecardopedia__Pwa__ServiceWorker__Logic__.js. Deployed JS/CSS are served stale-while-revalidate under PWA_SW_VERSION_TOKEN (:229, '2026-09-18-1'). New modules, edited importers (ModeController, Loader, TabStrip) and the self-injected statement CSS would hit the stale-stylesheet fault TV hit in v2.97 unless the token is bumped.
findings.recommendation: Bump the token in the release that adds the tab. Optionally add the two statement stylesheets to PWA_SW_SHELL_PRECACHE_RELATIVE (:260), as TV does (:763-764).
findings.evidence: VV SW logic :229 token, :260 precache list, :96-103 localhost network-first note; TV SW :763-764.

findings.title: .gitignore allowlist for VV statement folders
findings.detail: A statement folder holds photography; RB05's is 713 MB. TV's .gitignore (:115-136) allowlists only .md, .html and .json under na-project-portal/**/10__StatementDocs/**, and ignores 00__Archive, 00__Archived and 00__Images. VV's repo .gitignore has no such rule, so the first statement under WCP/Projects would leave its photography one 'git add' away from the repository and GitHub Pages.
findings.recommendation: Add the same allowlist for WebApps/Whitecardopedia/Projects/**/10__StatementDocs/** (plus the 00__ parking folders) to the VV repo's root .gitignore before any VV statement exists.
findings.evidence: TV NaWeb .gitignore :115-136; D:/10_CoreLib__ValeCodebase/.gitignore has no Projects image rules beyond one glb line.

findings.title: Open Sans Medium (500) missing from VV fonts
findings.detail: The document stylesheet sets headings and bold at Open Sans weight 500; TV added the Medium face in v2.95. VV's Na__CoreUi__Styles__Fonts__.css declares only 300, 400 and 600, served from noble-architecture.com assets, and Core__BrandAssets has no Medium TTF. Statement headings would render in a synthetic weight, and the Typography harness would fail.
findings.recommendation: Add an Open Sans 500 @font-face to VV's fonts CSS, using either TV's CommonFont-01__OpenSans__Medium__.ttf (na-apps common assets, public URL) or a VV-hosted copy. Publish__Page__ copies these rules into published statements.
findings.evidence: VV Fonts CSS :8-34 declares weights 400/600/300; TV Fonts CSS :40-45 declares weight 500.

findings.title: VV's styled confirm modal vs TV's window.confirm
findings.detail: VV index.html includes the #naConfirmDialog markup (:1323), so ConfirmDialog__Show shows a styled modal (z-index 9999) for statement delete, adopt, sync and cloud-overwrite questions. TV's Index.html lacks the markup, so TV falls back to window.confirm; TV v2.167 notes this, and TV's tests stub window.confirm.
findings.recommendation: Keep VV's modal. VV browser tests must answer the modal rather than stub window.confirm. Back-port the markup to TV's Index.html.
findings.evidence: VV index.html :1323-1329; VV DropdownAndToast CSS z-index 9999; TV devlog v2.167 'Not done' item.

findings.title: Design Statements tab label, placement and a config gate
findings.detail: TV labels: StatementsTab 'Design Statements' and StatementsTabTitle 'The written documents of this project' (AppConfig :595-596). In v2.158 the choice between 'Design Statement' and 'Design Statements' was left open as Adam's call. The tab shows whenever the strip shows, even when there are no statements. VV's strip (1.5.0) shows one tab per sheet.
findings.recommendation: Use the TV labels verbatim in VV config. Add LayoutEditor__Statement__Enabled (default true, back-ported to TV) so VV can hide the tab without diverging in code if Adam decides Vale does not use statements.
findings.evidence: TV TabStrip :358-361; TV devlog v2.158 'Still Adam's call' :1131-1138.

findings.title: VV has no project display-name source (TrueVision__Pwa__ProjectContext)
findings.detail: The hub reads the project display name from window.TrueVision__Pwa__ProjectContext (TrueVisionHub__.js :206), which is a TV PWA global. VV never defines it. VV's own SpecPdf__.js (:147) already has the same dead reference, so VV's spec PDF never shows a project name.
findings.recommendation: Give VV one project-name source (project.json projectName via the presentation-mode project JSON) and use it in both the hub and SpecPdf.
findings.evidence: VV 50__Feature__Specification/Na__LayoutEditor__SpecPdf__.js :145-149; grep finds no TrueVision__Pwa__ProjectContext definition in VV or WCP.

findings.title: Seven node suites must run on a VV fixture, not live project files
findings.detail: Seven node suites (Lockstep 28, RoundTrip, FigureTitle 32, Standard 45, Schedule 64, Finishes 59 and Publish 87 checks; 1,907 lines) copy the real modules into a scratch ES tree. Five of them read the live RB05 statement, and on 01-Oct they fail 2, 1, 5, 1 and 3 checks respectively. The causes are CRLF, edited content, and a stale hub-wording expectation at Standard :249. VV has no statement to read.
findings.recommendation: Port all seven against a committed VV fixture statement, never a live project file. The fixture needs headings, sections, dividers, figures with titles and a crop, a comparison table, the house header and footer blocks, and a CRLF twin. Point Publish's CDN base at VaApps/Projects.
findings.evidence: TV run 01-Oct (TEMP redirected): Lockstep and Publish PASS; RoundTrip 2, FigureTitle 1, Standard 5, Schedule 1, Finishes 3 FAIL.

findings.title: Six browser harnesses and the reference Typora CSS
findings.detail: Six browser harnesses prove what node cannot: DomRoundTrip 175, Typing 229, Figure 284, Typography 235 (plus Na__Test__Reference__TyporaTheme__.css, 545), Standard 77 and Finishes 105 lines. They cover real contenteditable typing with trusted keys, figure markup rules, typography against the real theme, and standard sections rasterised through html2canvas. They load modules by relative path and read RB05 from na-project-portal; Standard.html also loads TrueVision__Pwa__ProjectContext__.js (:27).
findings.recommendation: Port them to VV's 80__Testing__PrototypeEnvironment, pointing ?statement= at the VV fixture and serving through WCP Flask. Drop the TV PWA script and keep the reference CSS verbatim.
findings.evidence: Harness headers; DomRoundTrip :132-133 RB05 URL; Finishes.html :38 RB05 path.

findings.title: Statement end-to-end test server
findings.detail: Na__Test__StatementServer__.py (240 lines) serves the repository uncached and registers the real statements blueprint against a throwaway copy of a project's statements folder: markdown is copied and photography hard-linked. It answers /api/health and the sibling index route. It cannot stop Cloudflare writes.
findings.recommendation: Port it as a VV test server that imports WCP/Server__ValeVisionStatements__Api__.py against a temp Projects root, answers /api/check-localhost and /api/editor-config with a fake key, and blocks worker writes.
findings.evidence: Server header :12-35; blueprint registration :130; health :134; sibling route :139.

findings.title: Export and module-graph verification gates the port
findings.detail: TV verifies every statement release with Na__Verify__Exports__.mjs (542 files at v2.172) and Na__Verify__ModuleGraph__.mjs; VV has both. The page's static import closure reaches 274 TV files, 115 of which are absent in VV (47,730 lines), mostly via Register__Pdf__, Share__Button__ and PdfExporter__. A partial port will not link.
findings.recommendation: Run both VV verifiers after every statement WP and treat a missing export as a blocker. Gate WP-S07b-05 on the prerequisite slices having landed, or on agreed stubs.
findings.evidence: Closure script from Statement__Page__.js: 274 files, 115 VV-missing; VV 80__Testing__PrototypeEnvironment has Na__Verify__Exports__.mjs and Na__Verify__ModuleGraph__.mjs.

findings.title: No ledger section for the Statement Writer; TV notes name a stale key-map file
findings.detail: VV's parity ledger has no Statement Writer section: its return trips stop near TV v2.85, and the feature begins at v2.95. VV's plan and devlog never mention it, and neither does TV's realign plan. TV's NOTES section 14 still names the key map Na__LayoutEditor__DocumentKeys__Config__.json, although DocumentKeys 1.1.0 renamed it Na__Hotkeys__DocumentTabs__.json.
findings.recommendation: Add a 'Return trip - Statement Writer (TV v2.95-v2.172, HEAD b2aa9151)' section to the ledger, with one row per file (verbatim or adapted) and the transport divergence. Fix TV NOTES section 14, and write VV notes for the feature.
findings.evidence: grep -i statement: ledger 1 unrelated hit, VV plan 0, TV realign plan 0; DocumentKeys__.js :69-70 and :103 name the renamed file.

findings.title: VV worker authenticates statement writes; TV's does not
findings.detail: TV v2.169 records that na-truevision-api has no authorisation: /r2/write, /r2/delete, /r2/upload and /r2/copy accept any caller whose key starts with NaProjectPortal/. VV's worker validates X-Editor-Api-Key on every non-OPTIONS request and guards paths per route. The statement transport is where this difference matters most, because one Publish writes dozens of files.
findings.recommendation: Keep VV's authenticated, per-route design for the statement routes (DIV-4). Record it as a permanent divergence in the ledger, and offer it to TV as the fix v2.169 left as Adam's call.
findings.evidence: TV devlog v2.169 :262-271; VV worker index.js na_validate_api_key :112-116, 401 at :148.

findings.title: TV-side prep: route all IO through Transport, move branding into config
findings.detail: Seven or more files touch storage or branding directly. Publish, Publish__Images and Editor__Cards call CfApi, LocalMirror or TV routes instead of the Transport unit. Data, Page, Publish__Page, Header, Footer and Contents hard-code NA strings or Na__TrueVision__ storage keys. Registry's DEFINITIONS cannot be filtered. Each of these becomes a VV seam.
findings.recommendation: Do this in TV first (D-S07b-09). Route all IO through Transport, with new exports for picture store, location and write. Move branding strings and storage prefixes into LayoutEditor__Statement__Config and the standard config, and add a DEFINITIONS filter. VV then adapts one file plus config.
findings.evidence: Seams listed in S07b-F05, F12, F14, F18, F19, F22, F25.

findings.title: House document style: NA olive or Vale navy
findings.detail: The document stylesheet is Noble Architecture's Typora theme, with olive #555041 headings and bold. VV's brand blue is #172b3a (--Vale_PrimaryBrand), the same navy the TV hub uses. The identical NA theme already sits at VV's git root as VSCode_MarkdownRenderStyle_CoreStandard.css (v2.1.1), so Adam already writes Vale markdown in it.
findings.recommendation: Port verbatim now for an identical experience. Add colour tokens later only if Vale wants navy statements (D-S07b-05).
findings.evidence: Document CSS colour scan (#555041 many, #172b3a hub); VV AppHeader CSS --Vale_PrimaryBrand #172b3a; VV root markdown CSS header 'v2.1.1'.

findings.title: Keep the deliberately text-free PDF for Vale
findings.detail: The statement PDF is rasterised on purpose, so that a case officer cannot paste it into a language model; TV calls changing this a change of policy, not a bug fix (LayoutEditor__Statement__PdfNote). Every other PDF in VV writes real text.
findings.recommendation: Keep the policy in VV (D-S07b-07). The two presets (1.50/0.80 default and 2.00/0.92 print) stay in config.
findings.evidence: TV NOTES sections 5 and 13; AppConfig PdfPresets; TV devlog v2.99.

findings.title: TV feature is still moving and unconfirmed: when, and from which commit, to port
findings.detail: Sixteen TV releases touched the feature between 20 and 29 Sep, each marked 'NOT confirmed by Adam'. Commit b884e290 (30-Sep) changed hub words after the last devlog entry, without a version bump. Five of the seven TV suites are red on 01-Oct. Porting now means chasing a moving target and importing a design Adam has not confirmed.
findings.recommendation: Port from a pinned TV commit (HEAD b2aa9151 or later) after Adam signs the TV feature off. Record the commit in each PORT NOTE and in the ledger, and port each file's HEAD version rather than its devlog version.
findings.evidence: git log on the feature: 29-Sep commits carry v2.162-v2.172; b884e290 is the only post-devlog change; HEAD b2aa9151 does not touch the feature.

findings.title: Delete to quarantine in the VV blueprint
findings.detail: TV's statements delete route removes a folder with shutil.rmtree once confirm equals path. VV's scrapbook API never unlinks: deletes move to 00__Deleted__Quarantine. A statement folder holds someone's writing and its photography.
findings.recommendation: Make the VV blueprint delete into a quarantine folder; the 00__ prefix keeps it out of the image search and the git allowlist. Offer the same change to TV (D-S07b-08).
findings.evidence: TV API :412-449; VV Server__ValeVisionScrapbook__Api__.py header 'A delete never unlinks'.

findings.title: Index schema and statement folder conventions stay identical
findings.detail: Several formats are app-neutral: the index document (Statement__* keys; Doc__Id, Folder, File, Title, PublishedIso; Doc__Images with Img__Src, Path, Url, Bytes, Width, Height, SourceWidth, SourceHeight), the standard-section marker format, the figure-block markup, and the in-folder conventions (02_StatementDocs__Content__Images, 01_Images__ReferenceImages, and 00__Images parking with its manifest).
findings.recommendation: Keep them identical in VV so a statement folder can move between the apps and the same tests apply. Only the index file name differs (ValeVision__StatementDocs__.json).
findings.evidence: Data__Index__.js keys; Publish__.js :291-301 Doc__Images fields; TV NOTES sections 1, 16 and 17.

findings.title: No dependency on Sheet Images, Document Publishing, Spell Check, Colour Palette or the Published Schema
findings.detail: The Statement Writer imports none of 54__Feature__SheetImages, 65__Feature__DocumentPublishing, 55__Feature__SpellCheck, 54__Feature__ColourPalette, 52__System__Layout__PublishedDocuments or 53__Data__Layout__PublishedSchema. For spelling it uses the browser's own spellcheck (Editor :243, Cards :502). Its only link to publishing is the share-link manifest, which is re-recorded after a statement publish.
findings.recommendation: Those slices can go ahead independently of this one; only DocumentSharing needs to coordinate (S07b-F35).
findings.evidence: Import extraction of all 33 files; grep 'statement' in 52/53/65/80 folders: only the PublishedSchema ShareLinks note.

findings.title: UK-planning wording in the defaults
findings.detail: The defaults assume UK planning documents. The starter and header fields are Applicant, Site Address, Local Planning Authority, Prepared By and Document Version; the manager placeholder is 'Design and Access Statement'; and the finishes vocabulary (NEW, MATCHES EXISTING, [TO CONFIRM]) comes from the design-and-access-statement skill.
findings.recommendation: Keep the field names in VV, since Vale's orangeries also go through UK planning, and replace only the people and company names (D-S07b-04).
findings.evidence: Data__.js STARTER :168-198; Header__.js :88-96; Manager__.js :308; Standard config FinishesComparison block.

work_packages.title: Statement Lockstep leaf (prerequisite for the Specification lockstep)
work_packages.scope: Port 01__Core__Data/Na__LayoutEditor__Statement__Lockstep__.js verbatim from TV HEAD (VALEVISION3D header, PORT NOTE) together with its node test. This unblocks the Specification slice's port of TV v2.163.
acceptance: node 80__Testing__PrototypeEnvironment/Na__Test__StatementLockstep__.test.mjs passes 28/28 in VV
Na__Verify__Exports__.mjs passes
SpecData__Lockstep__ (when ported) imports it at the TV-identical relative path

work_packages.title: TV-side back-port prep (optional, recommended; TV repo)
work_packages.scope: In TV: route all statement IO through the Transport unit (new exports for picture store, file location and write; Publish, Publish__Images and Editor__Cards stop importing CfApi/LocalMirror). Move branding strings and storage prefixes into config (Data STARTER, localStorage prefixes, Page title, Publish__Page generator, Header/Footer/Contents defaults), and add a config filter on Registry DEFINITIONS. Make Md__Tokenise CRLF-tolerant while byte-exact, and add .gitattributes eol=lf for statement md/html/json. Switch the live-RB05 tests to a frozen fixture plus a CRLF twin, fix the stale Standard test (:249), and correct the key-map filename in NOTES section 14.
acceptance: All 7 TV statement node suites green on a frozen fixture and on its CRLF copy
grep shows no CfApi/LocalMirror import outside Na__LayoutEditor__Statement__Data__Transport__.js
No 'Noble Architecture' or 'TrueVision' runtime string left outside config files
Na__Verify__Exports__.mjs passes in TV

work_packages.title: VV statement transport: worker handler, Flask blueprint, AppUtils client
work_packages.scope: Build VV's own transport (DIV-4). Worker routes: GET/POST /api/editor/projects/{folderId}/statements/index and /statements/file?path= with X-Editor-Api-Key, guarded to VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/10__StatementDocs/ (TV segment/suffix/depth rules, 25 MB cap). Flask blueprint at /api/valevision/statements: index GET/POST, tree, file GET (Last-Modified, 404 JSON when missing) and POST, image, folder, move, delete (confirm equals path, to quarantine), fenced after resolution to Projects/{year}/{folder}/10__StatementDocs. Client Na__AppUtils__R2StatementDocs__.js following R2DrawingNotes. Nothing may read through serve_static.
acceptance: Python API test (pattern of Na__Test__ScrapbookApi__.test.py) proves fencing (.., absolute, symlink, depth, bad segment, wrong suffix), size caps, a picture is never overwritten (__02), delete is refused without confirm, and a missing file returns 404 JSON
wrangler dev: 401 without key, 400 outside 10__StatementDocs, round trip of md/html/webp with correct content types
Client reads a missing statement as missing (never index.html)
WCP/server.py registers the blueprint; the worker routes it before the generic save route

work_packages.title: Environment and config prerequisites
work_packages.scope: Add LayoutEditor__Statement__Config with VV values (FolderName 10__StatementDocs, IndexFileName ValeVision__StatementDocs__.json, StylesheetUrl on VV's public origin, Html2CanvasScriptPath, lockstep and PDF presets) plus labels StatementsTab/StatementsTabTitle and an optional Enabled switch. Add Na__LeCfg__GetStatementSetup to VV EditorSetup and re-export it from ConfigState__. decisions_needed.question: Is the Statement Writer (Design Statements tab) in ValeVision's scope?
decisions_needed.options: (a) Full identical port with Vale words and VV's own transport. (b) Identical code shipped behind LayoutEditor__Statement__Enabled, off until Adam turns it on. (c) Out of scope: port only the Lockstep leaf and adapt DocumentSharing to drop statement links.
decisions_needed.recommendation: (a) with the switch from (b), default ON for parity. Schedule it last, after the prerequisite slices and Adam's sign-off of the TV feature. Port the Lockstep leaf now whichever option is chosen.

decisions_needed.question: How should the LF-only tokeniser be fixed, given that CRLF statements render with no headings, tables or rules?
decisions_needed.options: (1) .gitattributes eol=lf for md/html/json under 10__StatementDocs in both repos. (2) Make the tokeniser tolerate CRLF while keeping source lines byte-exact. (3) Normalise to LF on read, which breaks the byte-for-byte promise.
decisions_needed.recommendation: (1) + (2), done in TV first and then ported. Never (3).

decisions_needed.question: What storage layout and names should VV use?
decisions_needed.options: Statements folder 10__StatementDocs beside project.json, or under LayoutEditor/. Index file ValeVision__StatementDocs__.json. TV file pattern with numeric VV codes, or a Vale pattern.
decisions_needed.recommendation: Keep TV's folder name and patterns (config-driven), with the folder beside project.json and the index named ValeVision__StatementDocs__.json. R2 VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/10__StatementDocs.

decisions_needed.question: Should VV keep the UK-planning defaults (Applicant, Site Address, Local Planning Authority, the 'Design and Access Statement' placeholder, the finishes vocabulary)?
decisions_needed.options: Keep them, or replace them with Vale terms.
decisions_needed.recommendation: Keep the field names (Vale schemes go through UK planning too) and replace only the names of people and companies.

decisions_needed.question: Which house document style should VV statements use?
decisions_needed.options: Port the NA Typora theme verbatim (olive #555041), or restyle in Vale navy #172b3a via a token layer.
decisions_needed.recommendation: Verbatim now. The same theme already styles markdown at the VV repo root. Add a token layer later only if Vale wants navy.

decisions_needed.question: What happens to the TrueVision 3D Project Hub standard section in VV?
decisions_needed.options: (a) Exclude it from VV's DEFINITIONS via config. (b) A ValeVision 3D Project Hub with Vale words and the VV project URL (QR only once VV has a short-link resolver). (c) Keep the TrueVisionHub id with VV words.
decisions_needed.recommendation: (b) as a config-only adaptation if Adam wants the nudge in Vale statements, otherwise (a). Never ship TV copy.

decisions_needed.question: Should VV keep the deliberately text-free (rasterised) statement PDF?
decisions_needed.options: Keep it, or make the text selectable.
decisions_needed.recommendation: Keep it. It is identical to TV and is a policy, not a bug.

decisions_needed.question: How should the VV Flask blueprint delete a statement folder?
decisions_needed.options: shutil.rmtree, as TV does, or move it to quarantine (00__Deleted__Quarantine), as VV's scrapbook API does.
decisions_needed.recommendation: Quarantine, which is VV's convention and safer. Offer it to TV as a back-port.

decisions_needed.question: Should TV be prepared first (all IO through Transport, branding strings to config, DEFINITIONS filter, CRLF fix, frozen-fixture tests) before the VV port?
